idea-plugin.name: Ren'Py Release Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Find the .rpy lines that compile clean and only break inside a player's save

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Ren'Py Release Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/renpy-release-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/renpy-release-gate

action.text: Ren'Py Release Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run Ren'Py Release Gate on the file in the editor
